description: Blank Grabber logs are recognized as `information.txt` or `system.txt` by fields such as `Cellular Network`, `Computer OS`, `Discord Accounts`, `Roblox Cookies`, and `Wifi Passwords`. The observed layout groups them under `IP Info`, `System Info`, and `Grabbed Info`.
name: Blank Grabber
targets: Browser saved credentials, cookies, history, autofill
Crypto wallet desktop clients (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Exodus, others)
Game launcher sessions (Epic, Steam, Uplay, Battle.net, Growtopia)
